summary: Verified Order Timeline product thumbnails + clickable order references feature end-to-end. Backend GET /api/customers/{cid} correctly returns product_id/product_title/product_image on every timeline event (both order_created and status_change) and on recent orders. Frontend renders 44x44 thumbnails with proper fallback and all three click targets (timeline-thumb, timeline-ref, customer-order-ref) collapse the customer detail and navigate to the order-detail-page.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend get_customer uses a single batched $in lookup for product images — no N+1 (server.py ~L824-833).
product_image is stitched onto the shared _base dict so both order_created and status_change events on the same order share the exact same fields — good DRY.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test products (one with images, one without) + 1 test customer + 2 test orders with status transitions via public /api endpoints for coverage of both the image-present and null-image branches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test file test_timeline_product_thumbnails.py drives seeding through /api/products, /api/customers, /api/orders (uses ProductCreate/OrderCreate shapes; images must be array on product; orders POST expects product_id + quantity, not items/total). Playwright must click the row's first td (not the row center) because the status <select> intercepts default force-clicks. Verified against olivia.thompson@example.com (12 orders in DB).
rca of the issue: N/A - feature working as designed. 6/6 pytest passed; all 3 frontend click targets navigated to [data-testid=order-detail-page]; thumbnail rendered at 44x44 with proxied image URL and fallback PackagePlus icon rendered for orders whose product had no images.
